description: Monospace source-code editor with an optional Prism syntax-highlight overlay, Tab/Shift+Tab indentation (opt-out via TrapTab), copy-to-clipboard button and built-in JSON validation. Works without any JS/Prism as a plain monospace textarea; loading _content/Tempo.Blazor/js/code-editor.js enables the overlay and, when the host also loads Prism, syntax highlighting for the configured language. Long lines scroll horizontally unless Wrap is turned on.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Current code text. Binding this parameter gives you the raw source text.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires on every keystroke with the new value.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: Prism grammar id used for syntax highlighting (e.g. "json", "csharp", "sql"). Highlighting only activates when the host page loads Prism; without it the editor degrades to a plain monospace textarea. Null disables highlighting entirely.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Label shown above the editor.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder text shown while empty.

parameters.name: Error
parameters.description: Validation error message supplied by the host. Takes precedence over built-in JSON validation.

parameters.name: AnnounceError
parameters.description: When true (default), the error message renders with role="alert" so screen readers announce it assertively the moment it appears. Set false when the host moves focus to the invalid field after submit — the error is then read through aria-describedby on the control and the live region would announce the same text a second time. Only the role attribute is dropped; the message, its styling and the aria-describedby link remain. Only safe when the same render that shows the error also moves focus to this control. Keep the default for validation on blur or on input, async/server validation, or when focus stays on the submit button — otherwise the error is not announced at all. With several invalid fields, pair it with a summary (e.g. TmValidationSummary) or focus the first invalid field.

parameters.name: Rows
parameters.description: Number of visible rows. Defaults to 8.

parameters.name: MaxLength
parameters.description: Maximum character count.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables the editor.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Makes the editor read-only (selectable and copyable, not editable).

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: Marks the editor as required. Shows a required marker on the label and sets aria-required.

parameters.name: ValidateJson
parameters.description: When true and Language is "json", the value is parsed on every change and a localized error is shown for invalid JSON. The IsValid property exposes the result.

parameters.name: TrapTab
parameters.description: Keeps Tab and Shift+Tab inside the editor as indent/outdent. Defaults to true, which is how a source editor is expected to behave. Set it to false when the editor sits among ordinary form fields (a Gherkin step, a note): keyboard users then tab out to the next control instead of being trapped, at the cost of losing keyboard indentation.

parameters.name: Wrap
parameters.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling horizontally. Defaults to false, which suits source code where indentation carries meaning. Turn it on for prose-like content (Gherkin steps, descriptions) so a long sentence stays readable without horizontal scrolling.

parameters.name: ShowCopyButton
parameters.description: Shows a copy-to-clipboard button in the top-right corner. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: ShowFormatButton
parameters.description: Shows a pretty-print button for JSON content. Only rendered when Language is "json".

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: HTML id attribute of the textarea.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) applied to the root container.

parameters.name: DataTestId
parameters.description: Overrides the component's root data-testid (default "code-editor").

parameters.name: TestIdPrefix
parameters.description: Namespaces every internal data-testid as "{TestIdPrefix}-{name}" for unique targeting when multiple instances share a page.

methods.name: FormatJsonAsync
methods.description: Pretty-prints the current value as indented JSON. No-op when the value is empty or not parseable JSON.

properties.name: IsValid
properties.description: False when ValidateJson is on and the current value is not parseable JSON.
